description: Defines structures and functions for frequency domain resource allocation configuration in 5G NR, including resource block assignment, RIV calculation, and special case handling as per 3GPP TS38.214 specifications.

methods.name: ra_frequency_type1_get_riv
methods.description: Calculates resource indication value RIV based on resource block configuration.

methods.name: ra_frequency_type1_from_riv
methods.description: Derives resource block configuration from a given RIV.

methods.name: ra_frequency_type1_special_get_riv
methods.description: Calculates RIV for special cases where initial and active bandwidth parts differ.
